item.title: New deadline for enrolment
item.description: For a number of undergraduate programmes, the enrolment deadline has been extended and enrolment is still possible. The TOLC test required for admission must be taken at least 48 hours before the enrolment deadline. %0A%0A🔗 Learn more

item.title: Call for the English language development course in view of the B1 Preliminary (PET) exam - SOLD OUT
item.description: Registration is open for the English language development course with a view to sitting the Cambridge B1 Preliminary (PET) exam. Classes, for the whole duration of 20 hours, are taking place in person in November-December at the SLAM Centre according to the calendar reported in the call.%0A%0A📄 Read the call for further details
